article: VERSTAPPEN: 'AWFUL' RED BULL F1 RACE ENABLED NORRIS AUSTRIA COLLISION
text: Max Verstappen says Red Bull put itself in the fight with Lando Norris by doing 'everything wrong' in an 'awful' Austrian Grand Prix. Polesitter Verstappen looked set to dominate proceedings at the Red Bull Ring, building up an eight-second gap, until a string of slower pitstops brought second-placed Norris back into striking range.
